method: Phase 1 unknown-surface hunt over the frozen oracle source. Gaps = surfaces with observable behavior that have no court defined yet. This file is regenerated by each hunt; an empty list must itself be backed by the inventory sweep.

gaps.evidence: main.cpp:45-56 attach+detach retry path; behavior when the previous instance crashed without detaching

gaps.surface: alpm_db_search ordering within a sync db
gaps.evidence: kernel.cpp:184-197 relies on libalpm search ordering; not guaranteed by the ALPM contract across versions
gaps.note: ordering verified against real cachyos/core/extra dbs (row order == repo order × db cache order, matching alpm_db_search); an adversarial hand-built needle db is still unwitnessed

gaps.surface: chwd output format ($4 field) across chwd versions
gaps.evidence: kernel.cpp:45 `awk '{print $4}'`; malformed/missing output behavior is inferred, not witnessed
gaps.note: chwd wrapper models the REAL output format (observed on a CachyOS host: box table, whitespace-field 4 = profile name, kernel.cpp:45 awk '{print $4}'); the decision matrix is witnessed differentially through the transaction pacman argv

gaps.surface: mINI case-insensitivity effects on pacman.conf section names
gaps.evidence: ini.hpp header claims sections/keys are case-insensitive; the effect on a `[CORE]` section is unwitnessed
gaps.note: mINI case-insensitivity, testing/options skip, duplicate merge, Include-not-followed, malformed/missing files: all witnessed differentially against the oracle

gaps.surface: terminal-helper exit-code surface for each emulator
gaps.evidence: terminal-helper final line precedence; only kgx-failure avoids exit 2 — unwitnessed for each emulator
gaps.note: exit-code surface witnessed per scenario with controlled stubs: none->1 (temp file LEAKS), first-fails->2, kgx-fails->0, success->2 (!), -s override; the 'success->2' result is the `A || B && C` precedence quirk — eval success also exits 2 (only kgx-failure avoids it)

gaps.evidence: conf-window.cpp:734 vs aur_kernel.cpp:53; -s/--syncdeps interplay with AUR deps is unwitnessed
gaps.note: the -scf (repo) vs -sicf (AUR) command construction is courted byte-for-byte by build-env/lifecycle (build_command + aur_build_command) and aur/enablement-matrix (build-aur argv); the runtime dependency-resolution difference of -s vs -i is a makepkg/AUR semantic documented in the atlas, not re-executed in the VM

gaps.surface: sudo vs pkexec boundary in artifact install
gaps.note: the FULL escalation chain is witnessed in the transaction strace: terminal-helper -s 'pkexec /usr/lib/cachyos-kernel-manager/rootshell.sh' -> xterm -e pkexec rootshell.sh <tmpfile> -> bash <tmpfile> -> pacman; the polkit policy byte-identity is courted

the script itself is the contract (byte-identical packaged copy); runCmdTerminal's FailedToStart->exitCode()==0 semantics are reproduced in cachyos-kernel-manager-exec::run_cmd_terminal (courted at the unit level; the script's own exit paths witnessed in the matrix)

gaps.surface: Qt translation catalog `zh-CN` alias vs QLocale `zh_CN` lookup
gaps.evidence: qrc alias zh-CN vs QLocale zh_CN; whether the oracle ever loads zh-CN is unwitnessed
km-window.cpp:327-338 releases alpm without joining the worker
